events.title: League One side 렉섬 enters financial administration . Under new Football League rules, the club is penalised 10 league points, placing the club in relegation danger.

AFC 윔블던 lose 2–0 to Cray Wanderers , ending their United Kingdom record run of consecutive unbeaten league games in senior football at 78, having last lost a league game in February 2003 when they were playing in the Combined Counties League .
사우샘프턴 sack Steve Wigley after only 14 games in charge. The Saints announce 해리 레드냅 , who resigned as manager of their local rivals 포츠머스 only two weeks ago, as their new manager.
FC 포르투 defeats Once Caldas 8–7 on penalties in the Intercontinental Cup final in Yokohama , Japan.
Dutch club NEC fires manager 요한 네이스컨스 . He is replaced by former player Cees Lok .
보카 주니어스 defeats Bolívar 2–1 on aggregate to win the Copa Sudamericana final in Buenos Aires , Argentina.

첼시 finish 2004 as Premier League leaders by an eight-point margin over second-placed 아스널, who have a game in hand. 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 에버턴's recent run of good results keeps them similarly competitive as they are the next nearest threat, level on points and nine points off the top. 미들즈브러 complete the top five, with strong competition from 리버풀, 찰턴 애슬레틱 and a resurgent 토트넘 홋스퍼. 웨스트브로미치 앨비언, with just one win so far this season, prop up the top flight with a mere 11 points. 사우샘프턴 and 노리치 시티, both with just two wins so far this season, complete the bottom three, but are cranking up the pressure on 크리스털 팰리스, 풀럼 and 블랙번 로버스. 입스위치 타운 and 선덜랜드 lead the way in the Championship, with 위건 애슬레틱, Reading, 셰필드 유나이티드 and 밀월 completing the top six.
